blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and transfer to José María Córdoba Airport to take the flight (not included) to Santa Marta. It is suggested to take the flight in the morning. Arrival at Simón Bolívar Airport in Santa Marta. Welcome and assistance, and transfer to the hotel. Free time for lunch (Lunch not included).

In the afternoon, city tour by the main avenues and visiting the Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino, an old sugar mill where Simón Bolívar -the liberator of Colombia- spent his last days. Here you can see three different collections, the historical collection, the modern collection, and the botanical garden. Visit to the Minor Basilica Cathedral, Gold Museum or Customs House, where Simón Bolívar was alive and dead, and which today is the Gold Museum. Appreciation of an extraordinary collection,

which puts in context the cultural heritage, and observation of the beautifully restored colonial house that invites you to explore the past and present of Santa Marta. Return to the hotel.

Duration: 04 hours.

Includes: Entrance fees to the described places, bilingual guide, private transportation, and local medical assistance card.
